gsd-sdk run.description: Run full milestone autonomously against a project directory

gsd-sdk phase.description: Run a single phase lifecycle (discuss -> research -> plan -> execute -> verify)

gsd-sdk init.description: Bootstrap a new GSD project from a PRD or prompt

gsd-sdk auto.description: Autonomous loop: optionally init then run milestone

gsd-sdk query intel.extract-exports.description: Extract exported symbols from a source file

gsd-sdk query intel.patch-meta.description: Update _meta.updated_at timestamp in an intel JSON file

gsd-sdk query intel.validate.description: Validate intel file structure and exports correctness

gsd-sdk query intel.snapshot.description: Write .last-refresh.json with hashes of current intel files

gsd-sdk query intel.status.description: Show intel file freshness (stale/fresh status per file)

gsd-sdk query intel.query.description: Search intel files for a term

gsd-sdk query intel.diff.description: Show changed intel entries since last snapshot

gsd-sdk query state.*.description: STATE.md read/write operations (load, get, snapshot, update, patch, begin-phase, planned-phase)

gsd-sdk query roadmap.*.description: ROADMAP.md analysis, phase extraction, plan progress update, requirements mark-complete

gsd-sdk query phase.*.description: Phase lifecycle operations (add, insert, remove, complete, scaffold, list, next-decimal, milestone.complete)

gsd-sdk query config.*.description: Config read and model resolution operations

gsd-sdk query verify.*.description: Verification checks for plans, phases, artifacts, commits, references, schema-drift

gsd-sdk query template.*.description: Template fill and selection operations for plan/summary/verification docs

gsd-sdk query commit.description: Commit planning docs to git; commit-to-subrepo routes to sub-repos

gsd-sdk query workstream.*.description: Workstream lifecycle: list, create, set, status, complete, progress

gsd-sdk query summary.*.description: SUMMARY.md extraction and history digest aggregation

gsd-sdk query uat.*.description: UAT checkpoint rendering and audit-uat scan across phases

gsd-sdk query websearch.description: Web search via Brave API (requires BRAVE_API_KEY)

gsd-sdk query profile.*.description: User profile pipeline: learnings copy/query, extract-messages, scan-sessions, generate-claude-profile, generate-claude-md

gsd-sdk query progress.*.description: Progress JSON/bar rendering, stats, todo operations (list, complete, match-phase)

node gsd-tools.cjs phase.description: Legacy CJS: Phase add/insert/remove/complete lifecycle operations

node gsd-tools.cjs roadmap.description: Legacy CJS: ROADMAP.md analysis and updates

node gsd-tools.cjs intel.description: Legacy CJS: Intel query, status, update, diff, snapshot, patch-meta, validate, extract-exports

node gsd-tools.cjs milestone complete.description: Legacy CJS: Archive milestone, create MILESTONES.md entry
